title: [v0.92.2][PLAT-PROVIDER] Consume validated editable provider definitions

Final local proof: 3 new definition regressions, 7 reload compatibility, 1 existing in-flight and 14 profile tests pass (25 total), plus clippy with warnings denied, formatting and diff checks. Restoring original ordering and scalar-traversal defects makes two new regressions fail; restoration passes. Constructor admission performs no completion, credential resolution or shadow evidence writes. Worktree only; independent exact-head review and PR CI pending.
